name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of replacing kitchen cabinets varies depending on the size of your kitchen, the construction grade of the cabinets, and any required layout modifications. Key cost drivers include cabinet materials (stock, semi-custom, or custom solid wood), hardware, and necessary wall preparation behind the boxes. Labor costs also reflect the complexity of wall leveling, drywall repair, finish carpentry, and coordinating sub-trades if plumbing or electrical outlets need relocation. Getting an on-site evaluation allows a contractor to inspect wall conditions, measure exact linear footage, and provide an accurate project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on cabinet materials, kitchen size, hardware choices, wall preparation, and whether plumbing or electrical lines must move to accommodate the new layout.
